## History

Carrie Sloane is a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who attends the local [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school. During Mr. Phillips's final day as teacher, Carrie is seen crying bitterly alongside her classmates, even though she had been punished by him earlier that very day. She later continues her schooling alongside her peers, benefiting from the arrival of the new teacher, Miss [Stacy](../character/stacy.md).
